text: My project plan has a contingency plan. Neither has met the project.
The project plan includes a separate section for possible delays.
Our loading spinner won employee of the month. It has been visibly working since Tuesday.
The application displays a loading indicator while it retrieves the requested file.
I made a schedule for being spontaneous. Naturally, I am already behind.
I reserved an hour on Saturday for an activity I have not selected yet.
The recipe said to let the dough rest, so I stopped asking it about its career plans.
Leave the dough covered on the counter for the interval specified in the recipe.
My laundry basket asked for a promotion. Apparently it has been managing a growing team.
The laundry basket is full, and there are additional clothes beside it.
The orchestra librarian filed a complaint. Too many notes, not enough notice.
The orchestra librarian distributed the updated sheet music before rehearsal.
The meeting to simplify our process now has three preparation meetings.
Three preparation meetings are scheduled before the process review.
I bought a tiny plant for my desk. It has already requested a window office and a watering assistant.
A small potted plant sits on the desk near the window.
I finally solved the mystery of the disappearing biscuits. The solution was eating the last one.
The biscuit container is empty because all the biscuits have been eaten.
My first attempt at origami is going well. The paper is now less flat.
The folded paper has several creases across its center.
